description: This file defines the 'SeoUrl' model class for the Opencart admin system, responsible for managing SEO URL records in the database including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving SEO URL data.
external_files: database configuration and connection related to $this->db
DB_PREFIX constant or variable for table prefixes

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Model class handling CRUD operations and retrieval of SEO URL records within the OpenCart admin 'design' namespace, extending the core system engine Model class.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO URL record into the database with specified parameters and returns the new record ID.

methods.name: editSeoUrl
methods.description: Updates a specified SEO URL record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrl
methods.description: Deletes a SEO URL record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes SEO URL records matching a specific key-value pair, with optional store and language filtering.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Fetches a SEO URL record by key and value, with optional store and language filtering.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record matching a specific keyword, store ID, and optional language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Retrieves multiple SEO URL records based on various optional filters such as keyword, key, value, store, and language.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Returns all SEO URL keywords grouped by store and language for a given key and value.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Fetches all SEO URL records associated with a particular store.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all SEO URL records associated with a particular language.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns the total count of SEO URL records matching optional filters.
